title: Co-located ship and AUV multibeam bathymetry corpus: processed grids, masks, co-registration and tile tables (companion data of GRL 2026GL125574)
description: Processed co-located seafloor bathymetry pairs for testing whether ship multibeam ranks unresolved meter-scale seafloor relief: 52 pairs, each a near-bottom AUV multibeam grid (1-5 m) and the independent hull-mounted ship multibeam grid (9-151 m native cells) of the same footprint, harmonized to a common UTM grid and co-registered, with validity masks, per-sounding ship product rasters, co-registration parameters, the datum statistic, and the frozen tile tables (s_lr, A_fine, held-out GBT_ship and P-V1 predictions) that reproduce every score in the paper. Groups: development (39 pairs, 16 units + EW0207), blind test 1 (5 pairs) and blind test 2 (8 sites), plus a manifest of excluded pairs. Both pre-registrations, the committed blind calls, deviation notes and scoring outputs are included. Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF, meters positive up, EPSG UTM codes. Sources: MGDS/IEDA, NOAA NCEI, PANGAEA, USGS; each source data set must be cited. The record is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; 27 pairs come only from CC BY / public-domain sources.
